Made in Melbourne, serving the world.

## Products

### Tankrich Social Media AI (the bot is called Tella)

- URL: https://www.tankrich.com/social-ai · Pricing: https://www.tankrich.com/social-ai-pricing
- A productised AI social media service for small business. Tella is the named bot each client gets: you text it a photo, a short clip or a couple of lines from your phone, Tella writes the caption or produces an avatar video in your own cloned voice, you approve it, and Tella publishes to every connected channel.
- Channels: Instagram (feed and reels), Facebook (pages and reels), LinkedIn (company and personal), TikTok. Multiple channel support is included on every plan, one approval publishes everywhere and each channel is reported back separately.
- Three post types: customer or job story, straight-to-camera avatar video, and single image post.
- Approval first: approval is on by default, and video approves twice, once on the words before any paid render and again on the finished video. Auto approval is opt-in per post type.
- Guardrails: Tella cannot invent a price, date, discount or percentage the client did not type; approved words are spoken verbatim; publishes are never silently retried, so no double-posting; screenshots and unusable frames are screened out; the cloned voice belongs to one consented person per business; there is no regenerate button, because changes are free before approval and paid after it.
- Pricing (AUD, excluding GST): one-off $750 setup covering the initial consultation, brand brief, channel connection and tuning Tella on the client's real photos. Then Option A Image Only $39/month (200 image generations, no video), Option B Image + Avatar Video $299/month (200 images, 35 avatar videos), Option C High Volume $399/month (300 images, 50 avatar videos), Option D Unlimited Generation, quoted individually, where the client brings their own server and API keys and Tankrich deploys, operates, monitors and updates the software on that infrastructure.
- Best suited to shops, cafes, trades, agents, advisers, clinics, coaches and multi-location businesses that generate photos daily but have no one to write and publish.

## Selected Case Studies (STAR)

- PatrolX Tech (patrolxtech.com), Field operations platform. iOS, Android and web apps with real-time GPS tracking, GPS-verified site visits, shift logging, incident reporting and multi-tenant administration. Result: distributed field teams accounted for end to end, replacing spreadsheet tracking with live, verifiable proof of work.
- Uniqweave (fpoapp.com), Factory process automation PWA for an Indian ethnic-wear and fabric workshop. 18 modules, four role-based permission groups, database-enforced stock and stage controls, Shopify sync, and an AI copilot. Result: the full production journey from fabric receipt to dispatch now runs auditably from a phone, with no specialist training.
- Number & Words (numberandwords.xyz), Adaptive NAPLAN practice platform with 10,000+ AI-generated questions across all domains, instant explanations and timed simulations.
- My Wealth Base (mywb.com.au), AI-native tool that automates ATO-compliant ESS income and CGT for every RSU vest and sale.
- PureVeg (pureveg.xyz), AI-curated, ad-free global directory of pure-vegetarian restaurants across 100+ cities, screening reviews for mixed kitchens.
- Tankrich MFD (tankrichmfd.xyz), Installable mutual-fund advisory PWA with goal-driven journeys, onboarding and real-time push notifications.
- Automated Reels Engine, End-to-end content pipeline that discovers topics (Reddit, trends, YouTube, RSS), drafts platform-native scripts with Claude, takes one-tap human approval via Telegram, and publishes weekly Instagram and Facebook Reels. Result: consistent short-form video output with no dedicated video desk.
- Autonomous Social Engine (x.com/onewiseidiot), Fully autonomous X/Twitter engine that generates, quality-scores and publishes original posts three times daily with no human approval and no external database. An in-house demonstrator of disciplined autonomous social AI, adaptable with human-in-the-loop controls for a brand's own voice.
- Market Intelligence Suite (signals.tankrich.com.au), Automated quantitative dashboards: momentum portfolios, global index signals, live commodity signals and on-demand fundamental analysis.
